---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something Larust doesn't do yet
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What's missing, and what's the actual problem it causes**

Describe the gap in terms of what you were trying to do, not just "add X" -
the underlying problem is what makes a request easy to evaluate.

**How does Laravel (or another framework) handle this, if relevant**

Larust is deliberately Laravel-shaped - if there's a Laravel equivalent
(or a convention from another Rust framework worth borrowing from
instead), mention it. See
[`rust-laravel.md`](../../rust-laravel.md) for what's already been
deliberately preserved, translated, or rejected from Laravel, in case this
overlaps with an existing decision.

**Proposed shape (optional)**

If you have a rough idea of the API/CLI surface this would need, sketch it
here - not required, just useful if you have one.

**Would you be willing to work on this yourself?**

Yes / no / maybe with some guidance - helps prioritize.
